methodology: Fresh canister per case/trial. Selected descending, ascending, shuffled, equal or duplicate-heavy priorities are filled outside measurement in bounded update chunks. All queues implement minimum-first behavior; Core PriorityQueue comparator is reversed. Core/fast Map use external key handles; plugin uses native handles. Four forced GC increments precede snapshots. Raw performanceCounter(0) and allocation/reclaimed deltas cover only measured loop including adapter/dispatch overhead, excluding reply and end-of-message GC. Heap snapshots are separate post-GC observations; Wasm memory is highwater and does not imply retained objects. Sorted drain verifies exact remaining priority/value multiset, count and sum after every operation; identity/layout is checked separately by native model tests.
